Dramaturgy in the Venisamhara

by Debi Prasad Namasudra | 2016 | 70,412 words 

Hinduism

Natyashastra

Buy relevant books

Summary
: This essay sudies the practical application of Sanskrit Dramaturgy in the Venisamhara of Bhatta Narayana: an extraordinary drama in Sanskrit literature which revolves around the great war of Mahabharata within six Acts. This study deals with the author, background and the technical aspects involved in the Venisamhara, (such as the dialogues, hero, sentiment and characterizations), reflecting the ancient Indian tradition of dramaturgy (Natya-Shastra).
